how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-arathi-basin-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8080:obj:0: Win the battle for ⟦E1⟧, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Sergeant Maclear at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:8080:details:0: War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!
rows.quest:8080:details:1: BThat is why ⟦E1⟧ is important. There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.
rows.quest:8080:details:2: BThat is what I want from you, ⟦1⟧. Enter ⟦E1⟧, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a crate of resources.
rows.quest:8080:completion:0: You got the resources! Great job! I'll send the resources to our quartermasters, who can quickly disperse them to our troops.
rows.quest:8080:completion:1: BThank you, ⟦2⟧. Indeed, performing successful missions like the one you achieved are how wars are truly won.
rows.quest:8105:obj:0: Assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the farm, then return to Field Marshal Oslight in Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:8105:details:0: ⟦3⟧, the battle for ⟦E1⟧ is a battle for resources and territory. Key points in the area must be held and operated in order to supply our forces with much needed raw materials and supplies. I charge you to assault the points farthest from our ⟦E1⟧ base.
rows.quest:8105:details:1: BAssault the farm, the mine, the lumber mill and the blacksmith when they are controlled by the enemy. Find the enemy's banner and rip it from its flag post!
rows.quest:8105:details:2: BWhen you have done this to all four points, return to me.
rows.quest:8114:obj:0: Enter ⟦E1⟧, capture and control four bases at the same time, and then return to Field Marshal Oslight at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:8114:details:0: ⟦4⟧, you have taken the battle of ⟦E1⟧ to our enemies and earned great honors in that field of battle. You have shown us your worth as a ⟦5⟧, and you have shown our enemies that we will not submit to their villainy!
rows.quest:8114:details:1: BBecause of your proven value to us, I have a difficult task for you. I want you to take and hold at least four of the bases in ⟦E1⟧. If you can do that, then we will not only secure critical resources, we will show the ⟦E2⟧ our dominance!
rows.quest:8115:obj:0: Control 5 bases in ⟦E1⟧ at the same time, then return to Field Marshal Oslight at Refuge Pointe.
rows.quest:8115:details:0: ⟦7⟧, battling for the resources of ⟦E1⟧ is a bloody undertaking. Your services to the League of Arathor are as needed as they are appreciated.
rows.quest:8115:details:1: BAnd we have one more task for you.
rows.quest:8115:details:2: BThe League wishes to make one strong push against the Defilers' occupation of ⟦E1⟧. We want them driven out of every strategic point on the battlefield!
rows.quest:8115:details:3: BIt will not be easy, but if anyone can get it done, it is you.
rows.quest:8120:obj:0: Assault the ⟦E1⟧ mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:8120:details:0: As you no doubt have heard, the League of Arathor is sending large numbers of troops into ⟦E1⟧. Eager for food and supplies, these ⟦E3⟧ fools are intent to take and control the rich resources there. We must show them that Arathi will never again be a home for humans!
rows.quest:8120:details:1: BGo to ⟦E1⟧ and assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the stables. Pull down the enemies' banners, declaring those territories for the ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:8120:details:2: BGo, ⟦8⟧. Report back to me when this task is complete.
rows.quest:8121:obj:0: Hold four bases at the same time in ⟦E1⟧, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:8121:details:0: ⟦9⟧, as the battles over ⟦E1⟧ rage, news of your actions have reached many ears. You are highly regarded among us, which gives me confidence that you will accomplish the mission I now have for you.
rows.quest:8121:details:1: BIt is time to send a message to the League of Arathor. We must show them that their holdings in ⟦E1⟧ are tenuous and quickly lost. We will show them this by holding, all at once, four strategic points in ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:8121:details:2: BSucceed in this, ⟦10⟧, and earn great respect among the Defilers.
rows.quest:8122:obj:0: Hold five bases in ⟦E1⟧ at the same time, then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.
rows.quest:8122:details:0: It is difficult to see, so deep we are in the conflict, but our spies report a weakening in the League of Arathor's resolve. We must use this window and strike a brutal blow against them! Return to ⟦E1⟧ and throw yourself against our foes. Curse them and kill them and control all five strategic bases! Send their soldiers screaming and bleeding from the front lines, with stories of your cruelty on their mewling lips.
rows.quest:8122:details:1: BDo this, and score a great victory for the Defilers.
rows.quest:8123:obj:0: Win the battle for ⟦E1⟧, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
rows.quest:8123:details:0: The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi. They, and all the races of the ⟦E3⟧, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe. We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.
rows.quest:8123:details:1: BYou can help us, ⟦11⟧. Enter ⟦E1⟧, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman. Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.

rows.quest:8370:obj:0: Bring 3 ⟦E1⟧ Mark of Honor to a ⟦E2⟧ Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
rows.quest:8370:details:0: Our conflict with the ⟦E3⟧ has escalated to a true war. No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.
rows.quest:8370:details:1: BThe battle for the ⟦E1⟧ is one of resources, plain and simple. Either the ⟦E3⟧ gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going. Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, ⟦36⟧!
rows.quest:8370:completion:0: Securing our resources in Arathi is an important task! You've done well, ⟦37⟧.
rows.quest:8374:obj:0: Bring 3 ⟦E1⟧ Marks of Honor to an ⟦E3⟧ Brigadier General outside the battlegrounds.
rows.quest:8374:details:0: Winning a war is about more than just outsmarting and outfighting your opponent. Victory often comes down to simply producing more than your enemy.
rows.quest:8374:details:1: BWhat we have in ⟦E1⟧ is a sizeable supply of resources for whichever side manages to claim it first.
rows.quest:8374:details:2: BIf the ⟦E3⟧ comes out victorious, it'll mean more swords and pikes for our troops. If the ⟦E2⟧ were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us! Now is the time to help the ⟦E3⟧ in ⟦E1⟧, ⟦38⟧.
rows.quest:8374:completion:0: Good work, soldier! Keep it up and we'll have the ⟦E2⟧ running all the way back to ⟦E4⟧.
